verdicts.reason: A has a consistent left margin and a strong, scaled-up headline. However, the CTA floats right-aligned between the subhead and the chips without sharing their left edge, so the reading order is odd (button before the flavour chips). The headline also nearly touches the right edge. B is broken: the wordmark, headline, subhead and chips all sit flush against the left canvas edge with zero margin, there are uneven dead gaps between the headline, subhead and chips, and the right side is mostly empty except for the CTA and a large circle.
